'''Hez's squad''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] unit that served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Led by [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[Hez]], the [[Squad/Legends|squad]] fought as a part of [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]] in the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]]. During the enusing battle, the squad was [[Death/Legends|eliminated]] by [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] forces of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==Description==
Made up of at least three [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and led by [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[Hez]], the [[Squad/Legends|squad]] was an [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] unit in the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion's]] [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]].<ref name="TCWn" />

==History==
===Attacking the monastery===
At least four members of the squad, including Hez,<ref name="TCWn" /> deployed with Torrent [[Company/Legends|Company]] of the 501st [[Legion/Legends|Legion]]<ref name="TCWf">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref> to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Teth/Legends|Teth]], in a [[Battle of Teth/Legends|mission]] to rescue [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] son, [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]], from [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] captivity<ref name="TCWn" /> in 22 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].<ref name="ERC" /> Hez's squad, along with the rest of Torrent Company, engaged with Confederacy forces and began scaling the walls of the [[B'omarr Monastery|monastery]] where the Huttlet was being held, led by two [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE walkers]]. Torrent Company sustained heavy casualties during the initial assault, including one of the walkers, but successfully reached the monestary. Sortly after the ascent, Torrent Company once again came under attack from [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|vulture droids]] strafing runs and numerous battle droids, which inflicted heavy [[Death/Legends|casualties]], including the remaining AT-TE walker.<ref name="TCWn" />

===Final stand===
{{Quote|If we can't stop them, then we delay them as long as we can, and after that we make sure they have to crawl over our bodies. It's been an honor, gentlemen.|Clone Captain Rex, addressing the surviving men of Torrent Company|<ref name="TCWn" />}}
[[File:Confederate_counterassault.png|thumb|left|250px|Confederate battle droids overwhelm the men of Torrent Company in the monastery.]]
As the battle progressed, the [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] of Torrent Company were forced to trap themselves within the monastery, as waves of Separatist [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] relentlessly assaulted their position. While [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] evacuated with the Huttlet, the squad, along with the survivors of Torrent Company, prepared a desperate defense against the Confederacy, laying explosives and [[Tripwire/Legends|tripwires]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droids]] breached the monastery doors shortly after, and engaged with the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] forces inside. Although the [[Gender/Legends|men]] of Torrent Company had prepared a well-laid trap, the battle droids overwhelmed and killed the clones inside,<ref name="TCWf" /> including Hez and his squad.<ref name="TCWn" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hez's squad first appeared in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|novelization]] of the [[2008]] film [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']]. The novelization was written by [[Karen Traviss]] and published the same year.<ref name="TCWn" />
